description: Owner decision 2026-10-16: the seed corpus should include TPC-H. Since #3006 the seed workflow stages only rankable bundles, and the TPC-H cells run without `--official`, so all 8 green TPC-H cells in run 38935736737 were skipped as `unofficial_compliance`. Change `.github/workflows/seed-corpus.yml` and `results-data/SEED_CORPUS_SPEC.md` so TPC-H cells run with `--official` (and a fixed seed, as TPC-DS does). Official TPC-H below SF1 is classed `unofficial_subscale`, so expect only SF1 cells to be admitted; decide with evidence whether sub-SF1 TPC-H cells stay in the matrix.
